verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is described as an AI coding agent that operates via a TUI where users give it natural-language tasks to read codebase, edit files, compile, test, and produce diffs, with slash-commands and headless modes accepting free-form instructions — this is the core interaction model of the product. Missing for 10: concrete example transcripts of natural-language prompts/responses and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that the NL interface works as described.
